title: Veil and Garden Again
author: Noor Amberdale
blurb: Kestrel Thackeray, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
